name: Effects
description: Effect cues shared by the Arena prompt builder and the local renderer.
source: Cupric effects registry, mapping notes in resources/kdenlive

items.name: Soft Grid
items.description: Subtle dark grid with soft radial vignette — marketing / stage only.

data.promptCue: Dark near-black base (#0B0B10) with a soft 48px grid at 3% white and a faint lime radial glow at center.

items.name: Dot Field
items.description: Sparse dot field — good for kinetic type and quote cards.

data.promptCue: Near-black field with sparse 1px dots every 24px at 8% white opacity.

items.name: Lime Haze
items.description: Two soft lime orbs, pointer-events none — brand energy without noise.

data.promptCue: Two soft orbs: lime at 20% 30% (12% opacity) and blue at 80% 70% (8% opacity) over #0B0B10.

items.name: Noise Paper
items.description: SVG noise grain overlay for paper-cut and editorial looks.

data.promptCue: Very light film-grain overlay (4% opacity, overlay blend) using SVG turbulence noise.

items.name: Mask Wipe L→R
items.description: Hard mask wipe left to right driven by t.

data.promptCue: Scene transition: clip-path mask wipe left-to-right as a pure function of t between scene from/to.
Logo enters with scale overshoot: 0.92 → 1.04 → 1.0, no CSS animation — pure function of t.

items.name: Hormozi Caption
items.description: Big bold captions, one lime highlight word, safe margins.

data.promptCue: Hormozi-style captions: 64px bold uppercase, warm white, one lime accent word, 80px safe margins.
Minimal lower-third: 18px medium, panel glass background, 8px radius, hairline border.

items.name: Word-by-Word Reveal
items.description: Kinetic type at ~9 words/s driven by t.

data.promptCue: Word-by-word kinetic reveal at ~9 words per second; visibility is floor(progress * wordCount).
Counter ticks with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; value is pure lerp of t.
